lead: Nvidia fell 4.34% to $166.19 after CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.
why: Nvidia said Huang resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately; the board accepted it Nov 11 and named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO.
The exit followed a board investigation opened Nov 8 and media reports about Huang's personal life; the WSJ reported the board was preparing to remove him.
Shares fell as much as 14% to $148.80 at the open before recovering to close down 4.3%.
Bernstein downgraded to Market Perform and cut its target to $200 from $400; Oppenheimer also downgraded.
Nvidia reports Q3 results Tue, Nov 17.
